page.overview:
Who is Jim Woo?

Jim Woo is a non-canon character that made his one and only appearance in the Mortal Kombat novel. He is one of the Black Dragon thugs that travel with Kano. A former bodyguard from Beijing who used to work for Mao Zedong and who drifted from job to job after his leader's death.

Well past retirement age, Jim's reflexes aren't anywhere near Kano's expectations, but his accuracy with throwing stars and his ability to roll up a newspaper so tight it would pass for a knife make up for this.
